cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN3109, from Wuhan to Beijing, you are now leveling at 8900 meters, expect OBLIK 25, make a position report to Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方3109，从武汉飞往北京，你现在在8900米平飞，预计25分到达OBLIK，向广州区调做位置报。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3109, leveling at 8900 meters, expect OBLIK 25.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方3109，8900米平飞，预计25分过OBLIK。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, Guangzhou Control, maintain present altitude, contact Beijing Control on 132.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，广州区调，保持当前高度，联系北京区调132.2。
cards.referenceText:
Maintain present altitude and contact Beijing Control on 132.2, CSN3109.
注：此处答案可以省略为：present attitude and 132.2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，联系北京区调132.2，南方3109。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar shows that there is a thunderstorm 33 miles ahead, you want to climb to 10100m to fly over it, contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的气象雷达显示前方33海里有雷暴，你想上10100米飞越雷暴，联系北京区调。]
cards.referenceText:
Beijing Control, CSN3109, our weather radar shows that there is a thunderstorm 33 miles ahead, request climb to 10100m to fly over it.
注：此处答案可省略为：Beijing Control, CSN3109, request climb to 10100m due weather/bad weather/adverse weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方3109，我们的气象雷达显示前方33海里有雷暴，请求上10100米飞越雷暴。

cards.audioText:
CSN3109, negative, but you can either turn left or right to go round it, which do you prefer?
[Tell controller you can make a left turn.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3109，不可，但是你可以左转或者右转来飞避它，你更喜欢哪一个？
[告诉管制员，你可以左转。]
cards.referenceText:
Request a left turn, CSN3109.
注：此处为被动报话格式：通话内容+己方呼号；go round：绕飞。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, turn left heading 270 for 5 miles, when clear of weather, return to the original route.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，可以左转270度飞5海里，当脱离天气，回到原航路。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 270 for 5 miles, wilco, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转270度飞5海里，照办，南方3109。

cards.audioText:
[Now you are clear of weather and back to the original course.]
CSN3109, descend to 7500m.
cards.audioTextZh:
[现在你脱离天气，回到原航路了。]
南方3109，下到7500米。

cards.audioText: During the descent, you encountered a strong hail and experienced heavy turbulence. The outer windshield of your aircraft cracked due to hail strike, tell your situation to Beijing Approach, and request emergency landing, this is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，你遇到了冰雹和颠簸。飞机外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，将情况告知北京区调，请求紧急着陆，这是一个遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, CSN3109, our outer windshield cracked due to hail strike, request emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 北京进近，南方3109，我们外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，请求紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, roger Mayday, cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, and you are No.1 in the landing sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，收到MAYDAY，可以ILS进近，跑道36右，你是第一个着陆。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, No.1 in landing sequence, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以ILS进近，跑道36右，第一个着陆，南方3109。

cards.audioText:
CSN3109, when able, state your situation.
[Inform the controller that your engines and control surfaces are working normally, but the outer windshield is cracked.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3109，可以的时候，陈述你的情况。
[告知管制员，飞机发动机和操纵面正常，但是外侧风挡玻璃出现裂纹。]
cards.referenceText: Our engines and control surfaces are working normally, but the outer windshield is cracked, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机发动机和操纵面正常，但是外侧风挡玻璃出现裂纹， 南方3109。

cards.audioText:
CSN3109, report persons on board and confirm whether you need medical services upon arrival.
[Inform Beijing Approach that you have 275 passengers on board and there is no injury report, so no medical assistance is required.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3019，报告机上人数，证实着陆后是否需要医疗救援。
[告诉管制员，机上有275名乘客，无人受伤，不需要医疗救援。]
cards.referenceText: We have 275 passengers on board and there is no injury report, no medical assistance is required, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们机上有275名乘客，无人受伤，不需要医疗救援，南方3109。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, continue approach and contact Tower on 118.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，继续进近，联系塔台118.6。
cards.referenceText:
Continue approach and contact Tower on 118.6, CSN3109.
注：此处答案可省略为：Continue approach and 118.6, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系塔台118.6，南方3109。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, wind 310, 5m/s, runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，风310度，5米每秒，跑道36右，可以落地。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, contact Ground on 121.8, good bye.
cards.referenceText:
Contact Ground on 121.8, CSN3109.
注：此处答案可省略为：121.8, CSN3109.

cards.audioText: [You find an Airbus 320 block the taxiway W6 ahead, you now want to change taxiway to E6, call Beijing Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你发现前方W6滑行道被一架A320挡住，你现在想更换至E6滑行道，呼叫北京地面。]
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3109, an Airbus 320 is blocking the taxiway W6 ahead, request change to taxiway E6.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，南方3109，前方W6滑行道被一架A320挡住，请求更换至E6滑行道。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, change to taxiway E6 approved, taxi with caution due the taxiway is slippery.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，可以更换至E6滑行道，跑道湿滑，谨慎滑行。
cards.referenceText:
Taxiway E6 approved, thanks, CSN3109.
注：题干中的change to taxiway E6 approved属许可，需要复诵。
